description_en: Changes the resource group to which a certificate or certificate order belongs
description_zh: 修改证书或证书订单资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun cas move-resource-group --resource-id cas-cn-4591d3xa0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmykgxu5d46ey --resource-type instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource.
Default value: instance Valid values: instance: certificate order Certificate: certificate
parameters.help_zh: 资源的类型。  默认值：instance
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region of the organization to which the owner of the certificate belongs. Valid values: ap-southeast-1 and cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 证书所有者所属组织的地域。目前仅支持ap-southeast-1（新加坡）和cn-hangzhou（杭州）
parameters.name: region_id
